item.title: 1960 Chevrolet Corvette 283/290 Fuelie 4-Speed
item.description: This 1960 Chevrolet Corvette is powered by a fuel-injected 283ci V8 paired with a four-speed manual transmission, and it received a Bloomington Gold Survivor Certificate of Historic Preservation in June 1997 as well as Bloomington Gold Certification, NCRS Top Flight, and MCACN Triple Diamond awards in 2025. item.title: 39k-Mile 2014 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Edition 507
item.description: This 2014 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Edition 507 sedan has 39k miles following registration history in California, and it is powered by a 6.2-liter M156 V8 paired with a seven-speed AMG Speedshift MCT automatic transmission. Finished in Iridium Silver Metallic over black leather upholstery, the car is equipped with Edition 507-specific features that include upgraded engine components, re-mapped engine management software, a vented aluminum hood, and gloss black exterior trim. item.title: 1972 Jaguar E-Type Series III Roadster Conversion V12 4-Speed
item.description: This 1972 Jaguar E-Type Series III left the factory as a 2+2 coupe and was converted to a roadster body style under prior ownership before 2007, and it was refurbished under current ownership between 2020 and 2025. Powered by a 5.3-liter V12 linked with a four-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential, the car is finished in black over cream-colored leather. item.title: 1940 Buick Series 50 Super Sport Coupe for The Automobile Gallery at No Reserve
item.description: This 1940 Buick Series 50 Super sport coupe is finished in green over tan cloth and is powered by a 248ci straight-eight linked with a three-speed manual transmission. The car was donated to the current owner, The Automobile Gallery & Event Center in Green Bay, Wisconsin, in 2025 after having spent approximately a decade in storage. item.title: 7k-Mile 2012 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG
item.description: This 2012 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG is finished in Obsidian Black Metallic over Designo Classic Red and Black leather and has under 7k miles following history in Texas, Washington state, and California. It is powered by a 6.2-liter V8 linked with a seven-speed dual-clutch automatic transaxle and features a Bang & Olufsen sound system, 19" and 20" 10-spoke wheels, gullwing doors, an airfoil, and heated power-adjustable AMG Sport seats. item.description: This 2016 Porsche 911 GT3 RS was initially sold in Washington and was acquired by the seller in 2016. Finished in white over black upholstery, the car is powered by a 4.0-liter flat-six paired with a seven-speed PDK dual-clutch transaxle. item.title: 34k-Mile 1977 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am
item.description: This 1977 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am shows 34k miles, and is powered by a 400ci V8 linked with a three-speed automatic transmission and a Safe-T-Track limited-slip differential. item.title: 1937 Bentley 4¼ Litre Saloon by Park Ward
item.description: This 1937 Bentley 4¼ Litre is a standard saloon with steel and aluminum coachwork by Park Ward, and it is believed to have been first registered in Scotland. By the 1970s, chassis B199KU had been brought to the US, where it spent more than five decades owned by author and automotive historian Paul R. Woudenberg of California. item.title: 2002 Nissan Skyline GT-R M-Spec Nür
item.description: This 2002 Nissan Skyline GT-R is one of 285 M-Spec Nür examples produced and was imported to the US by the current owner in October 2025. The car is powered by a twin-turbocharged 2.6L RB26DETT inline-six that has been fitted with NISMO R2 components and sends power to all four wheels through a six-speed manual transmission, an ATTESA E-TS PRO all-wheel-drive system, and an active limited-slip rear differential. item.title: 1995 Honda NSX-R
item.description: This 1995 Honda NSX-R is #349 of 483 first-generation Type R examples produced for the Japanese market between 1992 and 1995. Finished in Championship White, the car is powered by a 3.0-liter V6 mated to a five-speed manual transaxle with a 4.235:1 final-drive ratio and a limited-slip differential. It rides on white-painted Enkei forged alloy wheels and is further equipped with front chassis braces, a stiffened suspension, unassisted steering, and four-wheel ventilated disc brakes.
